metadata.source: metadata-scaled six-band reflectance and registered later date
metadata.high_signal_selection: within each 10 km block, top 10% of all eligible windows whose pair-centered index-difference score is at least 1; not a change-class prediction
metadata.random_background_selection: 18% of below-score-threshold patches sampled independently within each 10 km block
metadata.random_background_inclusion_probability: recorded per feature as candidate_selection_probability; not applicable to deterministic high-signal candidates
metadata.water_rule_reported_only: delta_mndwi < -0.3 and delta_ndbi > 0.1; this is recorded as evidence only and does not assign a change class
metadata.split_assignments: unassigned; no split has been applied
metadata.review_required: Each polygon is a 256x256-pixel review window, not an object boundary or label. Verify imagery, haze, seasonality, tide, shadow, registration, and historical evidence before labeling.
metadata.reference_policy: Do not consult information created after T2. Use historical OSM only at or before T2. If the two Sentinel-2 dates do not resolve the cause, retain uncertain or leave unlabeled.
